physiology:
The seat of this code is the pituitary, a soft pearl tucked at the base of the brain, sitting behind the bridge of the nose at about the height of the eyes. It is small, smaller than the tip of a finger, and the body has hung most of its inner weather on it. It listens to the dark and the light coming in through the eyes and then quietly tells the rest of the body what time of day it is, what season, whether to rest, whether to grow. A gland that translates light into instructions.

The shadow has its floor here. When the fog of borrowed certainties thickens, the body feels it in this region first, a dull pressure behind the eyes, a heaviness across the brow, a sense that the room is bright but you are looking at it through cloth. Sleep goes off. Dreams turn loud or go missing. The little gland that runs on light is being fed by a mind that no longer trusts what it sees.

The climb out is also bodily, and it is not dramatic. It starts as a softening behind the eyes. The forehead drops its grip. The pictures that come at the edge of sleep start to feel friendly again. Light reaches the floor of the brain and the body remembers it was built to drink from it. This code does not live in the head as an idea. It lives in the pearl that the head was built around.
amino_acid:
Deeper than the gland, this code answers to a single amino acid, Threonine. Threonine is one of the small set the body cannot make for itself. It has to be taken in, from the world, through food, broken down at the mouth and the gut and only then put to use. The body builds connective tissue with it, the collagen and elastin that hold a person together, and it shows up densely in the nervous system, where it helps keep nerve signals clean.

There is a teaching sitting in that quietly. The code of clear inner vision, the gene of light meeting the brain, rests on a letter the body has to receive. Even seeing is not self made. Even the chemistry of clarity is a chemistry of intake. Something has to come in across the line of the mouth before any of this can run.

The code goes all the way down to that. A clarity that has to be fed. A light that arrives, not from inside, but through the long patient work of taking in what was grown elsewhere.
